method: Current public pages inspected with T3 preview tools; saved screenshots are unmodified viewport captures. Prior award-entry imagery used only for historical Jitter/Luma comparison.
awardStatus: The new shortlist is selected for visual similarity. Awwwards wins are not verified for these six references.

references.name: FLORA
references.description: Black canvas, expressive serif headline, italic emphasis, and a loose composition of richly colored images. The surrounding interface stays quiet.
references.borrow: Use a small set of striking PPQ outputs around a clear headline. Let the examples provide the color and mood.
references.caution: The node-based workflow belongs to FLORA; PPQ’s demonstration should use its own chat and model-selection interface.

references.name: Framer
references.description: Large white sans-serif type, ample black space, compact navigation, and a broad product demonstration beneath the opening copy.
references.borrow: Use this spacing and hierarchy for the PPQ opening: one strong message, a clear action, and a substantial real-product preview.
references.caution: Its current page is more businesslike than Jitter. Carry over Jitter’s playfulness through the showcased outputs.

references.name: Spline
references.description: A minimal black shell, restrained gray controls, a prominent prompt field, example chips, and large scenes of the working editor farther down.
references.borrow: A particularly direct fit for PPQ’s existing prompt entry. Follow it with a legible demonstration of switching or comparing models.
references.caution: Keep text contrast strong; some animated headline states are intentionally very dim.

references.name: Unicorn Studio
references.description: Charcoal surfaces, an oversized expressive headline, muted supporting copy, and a colorful visual canvas. Decorative drawing details add a crafted character.
references.borrow: Use its balance of expressive imagery and neutral UI. It is a useful reference if PPQ should feel like a creative instrument.
references.caution: Its decorative frame is a brand-specific device. PPQ needs its own visual motif.

references.name: Huly
references.description: Oversized white headings, a dark atmospheric backdrop, a luminous vertical composition and a product window entering at the bottom.
references.borrow: Study the transition from a big visual idea into the working interface. Its warm CTA accent is relevant to PPQ’s orange.
references.caution: The bloom and glow dominate more than they do on Jitter or Luma. This is a stronger effects direction.

references.name: Rive
references.description: A black navigation shell and large motion examples with readable labels. The current version uses angular display type and a more technical layout.
references.borrow: Use a short, labeled example of what the product produces. Connect moving visuals to real capabilities.
references.caution: Its current typography and density are farther from the restrained Jitter/Luma direction.
